linux.reason: The pinned Provenance application is an Apple-platform Swift project; its official README does not publish a Linux application or Linux persistence/controller contract.
evidence: source:README.md platform badges and project description identify iOS, tvOS and macOS targets, not Linux @93f49b4

linux-flatpak.reason: No Provenance Flatpak manifest, package, or Linux sandbox persistence contract is published by the pinned project.
evidence: source:Provenance source tree and README contain no Flatpak target @93f49b4
official:https://provenance-emu.com/ official distribution links are Apple-platform artifacts

windows.reason: The pinned Provenance project does not publish a native Windows application or a Windows controller/configuration, save/state, firmware, or key contract.
evidence: source:README.md supported-platform badges identify Apple targets and omit Windows @93f49b4

macos.reason: The pinned project advertises a macOS target, but this catalog has no verified desktop build or source-backed six-purpose macOS persistence/controller path contract that Lunchbox can safely write.
evidence: source:README.md documents app-level save states, BIOS and controller features but not a stable Lunchbox desktop path grammar @93f49b4

controller_boundary.refusal: Do not invent a Provenance desktop controller file: the pinned Apple-platform project does not establish a stable desktop persistence and mapping grammar for Lunchbox. Apple runtime input, app container paths, and per-core save/state behavior require platform-specific inspection.

notes: Provenance is cataloged as an Apple-platform emulator frontend. The source advertises iCloud synchronization and app-level save states, but neither establishes one cross-host desktop controller/configuration namespace. Runtime Apple build and effective controller input were not verified.
